name: lumi-companion
description: Lumi – a little blue star that lives on your desktop and keeps you on top of your Google Calendar and Gmail, powered by a local Ollama agent.
author: finperiti

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n vite,main,app -c magenta,cyan,blue "vite" "tsc -p tsconfig.main.json -w --preserveWatchOutput" "wait-on tcp:5173 file:dist-electron/electron/main.js && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://localhost:5173 electron ."
scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.main.json && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && vite build
